# Screenshots

The main `README.md` references every image in this folder by exact filename.
Drop a 16:10 or 16:9 PNG (~1600 × 1000 ish) for each entry below and the
README will pick it up automatically.

Tip: capture on a desktop browser at 1280–1440 wide so the screenshots match
the typical first-time-visitor's monitor. Mobile shots are fine for
PWA-specific surfaces (e.g. screensaver), but the main feature shots look
better landscape.

## Required filenames

| File | What to capture |
| --- | --- |
| `login.png` | The login screen with the paint-splash background. Logged-out, fresh page. |
| `dashboard.png` | The Home dashboard for a parent — weather widget, today's events, balances, etc. |
| `calendar-month.png` | Month view with a few colourful events visible. |
| `calendar-week.png` | Week view with the live "now" indicator and at least one event spanning multiple hours. |
| `calendar-event-dialog.png` | The New Event dialog open with the recurrence + reminders sections expanded. |
| `todos.png` | To-do list with category tabs visible and at least one row showing a Sparkles "X pts" chip. |
| `shopping.png` | Shopping list grouped by category with a couple of items ticked. |
| `menu.png` | Weekly menu planner with several meals filled in. |
| `recipe-detail.png` | A recipe in detail mode showing the Cook Mode toggle and the hero image. |
| `birthdays.png` | Birthdays tab showing upcoming birthdays. |
| `reminders.png` | Reminders tab with a mix of Upcoming and Past entries. |
| `rewards-ledger.png` | Rewards → Ledger tab showing per-child cards + recent transactions. |
| `rewards-catalog.png` | Rewards → Catalogue tab from the parent view, with at least one item that has an image. |
| `rewards-fulfil.png` | Rewards → Ready to fulfil tab with a couple of pending redemptions. |
| `taxes.png` | My Taxes view showing the FY summary card and a list of receipts. |
| `maintenance.png` | Maintenance tab listing devices with a "next service due" pill. |
| `photos.png` | Photos tab grid with several images uploaded. |
| `screensaver.png` | The full-screen screensaver slideshow on a kiosk. |
| `settings-system.png` | Settings page scrolled to the Backup & Export and System cards. |

## Tips

- Use a clean profile (no real personal info, no credentials in screenshots).
- Dark mode shots are great for the kiosk surfaces (`screensaver.png`); light
  mode tends to look better on the calendar / dashboard.
- The README references images via relative path `.github/images/<name>.png`
  — keep that exact folder so the GitHub renderer picks them up.
- If you can't get a particular screenshot, comment out that image line in
  the main README rather than leaving a broken-image icon.
